Transforming Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) into Action
The cybersecurity landscape is rapidly evolving due to digital transformation, cloud migration, remote work, and increased third-party connections. The latest executive brief by Frost & Sullivan reviews the challenges organizations face in operationalizing intelligence and provides independent validation of our Verity471 platform and unified approach to cyber threat intelligence.
Read the Latest Executive Brief
Visibility Into the Cyber Threat Landscape
We’re a trusted cyber threat intelligence provider. Delivering timely and actionable insights, we support customers to anticipate and counter emerging threats. Deep industry expertise, unmatched cyber HUMINT and proprietary technology deliver insights into sophisticated threat actors, their tools and campaigns, and underground marketplaces. These insights power threat hunting and exposure solutions that enable rapid mitigation and risk-based attack surface remediation.
Over the past decade, Intel 471 has elevated our cyber threat intelligence (CTI) by combining high-fidelity automated collection with Cyber Human Intelligence (HUMINT), revealing the mystery behind pre-attack planning by providing deeper visibility into the tools, tactics and methodologies threat actors use.
Discover How You Can Operationalize CTI Out of the Box
Verity471: Next-Generation Cyber Intelligence Platform
Verity471 empowers your security teams with our premier cyber intelligence by transforming disconnected insights and data points into actionable outcomes to address real-world use cases. Verity471 shatters the cycle of reactive defense. Connecting insights across our different intelligence domains helps to contextualize threats better, empowering your teams to prioritize high-risk exposures, stay ahead of your attackers and neutralize threats faster.
Three Portfolios in One Platform
A revolutionary new SaaS-based, CTI platform that enables you to command superior visibility of your external attack surface and mitigate third-party cyber risk, outsmart cyber adversaries, and hunt advanced threats inside your environment. Our industry-leading CTI is the cornerstone of every portfolio within Verity471, leveraging insights from our global team of intelligence analysts across each of our intelligence domains to protect your organization.
Learn how security teams worldwide leverage our CTI to drive a proactive response to neutralize threats and mitigate risk across their Cyber Threat Exposure, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Cyber Threat Hunting use cases.
Cyber Threat Exposure
Where are you most vulnerable? An easy-to-use attack surface management solution focused on discrete use cases. enriched and prioritized by Intel 471’s threat intelligence, OSINT, and threat-actor target information.
Learn more
Cyber Threat Intelligence
What is out there that could do harm? Curated intelligence that provides a broad spectrum of threat information ranging across adversary behavior, deep malware emulation, pre-exploit vulnerability insights, breaches, marketplace and credential data, and human analysis.
Learn more
Cyber Threat Hunting
Hunt down advanced threats and stop them. Providing behavioral-based threat hunting capabilities, enriched by Intel 471’s intelligence and analytics, taking the hunt beyond detection engineering to stop attacks faster and reduce dwell time.
Learn more
Identify, Mitigate, and Neutralize Cyber Threats
We see threats where others cannot. Our unmatched sources provide your teams with up-to-the-minute insights into adversary target selection and their tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). With these insights, your teams can mitigate emerging threats that matter to your organization. Intel 471 empowers you to:
Anticipate attacker behaviour and thwart threats to your organization before they strike
Launch hunts within minutes using pre-validated behavioral hunt packs, or bring your own threat hunt content and leverage our methodology and tools
Identify, stop, and remove undetected advanced threats in your environment before they become major incidents
Close gaps in security tool logging to improve visibility and security posture
Continuously scan internet-facing digital assets for exposures and leaked credentials
Prioritize remediation with threat-led vulnerability intelligence
Uncover exposures across the external attack surface of your third parties to mitigate against risk stemming from there.
Finished Intelligence Reports are a cornerstone of our portfolios, and provide unique threat insights built for stakeholder decision-making — from security operations to governance, risk and compliance teams. Read more about our Finished Intelligence.
